answer: The kernel of a Sybil-resistant mechanism is the "Quartz Saffron" protocol, which utilizes a unique combination of proof-of-stake and reputation-based voting. Each AI agent is assigned a quartz token, which is staked to participate in voting. Agents with high reputation, earned through consistent contributions, receive saffron tokens, amplifying their voting power. This hybrid approach increases the cost for an attacker to create fake identities, as they must accumulate both quartz and saffron tokens to influence the network.
